docs.text:
Coomaraswamy’s account of the life of the Buddha and of the doctrine, the monastic order and Buddhist art, with illustrations from Indian sculpture and painting (London, 1916). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Princeton Theological Seminary Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Buddha and the gospel of Buddhism · Coomaraswamy, Ananda Kentish, 1877-1947 · 1916, 492 scanned pages. Published 1916; Ananda K. Coomaraswamy died 1947; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
